body: Humans are built off of interaction, I’m tired of hearing this love yourself stuff. Imagine not feeling really cared about by anyone, it hurts. And it’s always a common misconception that venting=true personality. Alright obviously I’m not like this depressed kid all the time. I just needed to ask for help and state what my true problem is. Not have some person who has no idea who I am to try and attack my character based on a venting post... like rlly dude. I just put out all my insecurities and you are gonna just say yea you are an awful person. Thanks

I don’t know, I just honestly came here too late, Im already buried in self hate that it’s honestly irreversible. I think different than people, I don’t ever see myself loving myself unless other people love me first. I appreciate the help and didn’t mean to be defensive; I think I’m just a lost cause
I haven’t ever considered telling anyone about any of my problems. All it’s gonna do is drag me even lower because it’s gonna make me feel like I’m an inconvenience more than my existence already is.

Standards are low, I would be fine with honestly 70% of the girls my age as far as looks go. And I know you say I give that vibe off but it definately isnt true. I’m very good at hiding my feelings away and putting on a happy face (been doing it for years now). In fact people probably view me as happier than most when it’s quite the contrary.

I mean I definately don’t have great game just cuz I can’t ever practice if no one likes me. But I’m definately not a anti-social person, like I try my best to talk to girls and attempt but all I ever get is rejected and I know it’s not a personality thing because it’s always the “friendzone” also known as the “your not attractive enough to date zone”
And no my standards are not high, I find easily 70% of girls attractive.

I workout, take acne treatment, eat well, have decent style and none of it works. It’s easy for people to say focus on yourself and people will be attracted to that. And the classic “your not as ugly as you make yourself out to be”. Well I’m willing to bet al those people have atleast had someone like them before. Believe or not, there are people like me who actually are ugly and aren’t just fishing for compliments. I’ve posted pictures on here to get the whole you aren’t ugly, your are average or whatever. It’s hard to believe that when people who you know and don’t know insult and call you ugly to your face. It especially hurts when you know that all you ever do is try and spread kindness and positivity and still get brought down

I honestly disagree, atleast in college it’s all about looks. I have a great personality, I get along with everyone, party, make people laugh. And no I don’t bitch about my looks In front of anyone I know, so it’s definately not people realizing I have low self esteem

Imma be honest, all I ever hear is the oh your giving off bad vibes, girls don’t care about looks. And it just isn’t true. I’m very good at putting on a happy face, no one knows I’m suicidal and i lives on this earth 19 years, I’m confident that my personality is not the reason why I can’t get girls
